name: NewSharedPropertyDialog
intent: Author a property reused across object types: display name, API name, base type, formatting and type classes.
when: Declaring a property several object types will share
Any create flow whose validation rules differ per host
whenNot: Adding a property to one object type -> do it on that type's detail page

chooseOver.because: Validation is a prop: the default is display-name-required, and a host needing more — a required API name, a uniqueness check — passes the full rule set in the order it wants them reported.

validate.note: Return a message to block creation. Defaults to display-name-required only.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.default: Display name, slugified API name, base type string.
states.refused: The validate rule's message is shown and creation is held.

evaluationCriteria: The host's validate rules are reported in the order the host gave them.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.

usage: Use NewSharedPropertyDialog when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
NewSharedPropertyDialog should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

anatomy.description: NewSharedPropertyDialog is composed of the following parts:

parts.name: NewSharedPropertyDialogTrigger
parts.description: Element that opens the dialog when activated.

parts.name: NewSharedPropertyDialogContent
parts.description: Container for the dialog content and overlay.

parts.name: NewSharedPropertyDialogHeader
parts.description: Header section containing title and description.

bestPractices.title: Focus management
bestPractices.description: Trap focus within the dialog and return focus when closed.

bestPractices.title: Don't nest dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid opening dialogs from within dialogs, use sequential flow instead.

bestPractices.title: Provide clear exit
bestPractices.description: Always include a visible close button and support Escape key.

bestPractices.title: Don't trap users
bestPractices.description: Never make dialogs impossible to close or require specific actions to dismiss.
bestPractices.example: // No close button or escape handling

bestPractices.title: Keep content focused
bestPractices.description: Limit dialog content to a single task or decision.

bestPractices.title: Don't overload dialogs
bestPractices.description: Avoid putting complex forms or multiple tasks in a single dialog.
